reason: 120 euros is a lot for something my phone already does for free, and I only look at my phone for half an hour before sleep, so it isn't a big problem for me. I'd rather spend that on something I use every day.
objection: Will the alarm still work if the Wi-Fi is down? If it fails once and I miss work, that's it. I also don't want to pay 120 euros for a second alarm clock that I still have to set up through my phone.
would_change_my_mind: A price around 50 to 60 euros, plus a clear statement that the alarm works with no Wi-Fi.
